opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants – Autumn 2026 round

amount.raw: Maximum grant amounts: New Projects and Commissions up to £20,000; Acquisitions and Collections up to £20,000; Conferences, Lectures and Publications up to £5,000; Long-Term Research up to £20,000; Research and Travel up to £2,500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non‑profit organisations (UK and international) can apply for New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions and Collections, Conferences, Lectures and Publications, and Long‑Term Research. Individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators can apply for Research and Travel grants.
opportunities.summary: Supports exhibitions, commissions, acquisitions, conservation, conferences, publications, long‑term research and research‑and‑travel projects related to sculpture.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships (Henry Moore Foundation)

amount.raw: Travel expenses up to £600 (UK), £700 (Europe), £1,000 (Rest of world) plus accommodation for the month

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics, curators, senior scholars and artists researching sculpture (including Henry Moore) may apply. Fellows spend a month using the Institute or Studios & Gardens facilities.
opportunities.summary: One‑month fellowships providing access to research facilities, accommodation, and travel/subsistence support for sculpture researchers.
